role: Revealed-territory layer: painted across the whole world grid and unmasked cell-by-cell as the player claims space; also the deploy thumbnail / OG image
description: the blazing galactic core of the Milky Way with dust lanes and nebula clouds

role: Unclaimed-space layer: dark void drawn under the play field with parallax star layers and drifting dust, animated (twinkle + drift)
description: empty deep intergalactic void with sparse faint stars and thin cold dust

role: Enemy sprites: 12 celestial bodies keyed to alpha and cut into individual round sprites (Sun, Mercury, Venus, Earth, Moon, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, lava exoplanet, icy ringed exoplanet)
description: twelve celestial bodies in a strict 4x3 grid on a green key background

role: Player craft: drawn at the player position, rotated to the heading, with an additive engine plume behind it
description: an unusual alien-engineered starship seen from directly above

role: Player trail: additive glowing energy line left across unclaimed space, pulsing; drawn in code
Death and capture feedback: particle burst of sparks and dust
description: burst of white-hot sparks fading to amber dust

role: HUD: claimed-percent bar, lives, level, score, minimap of the whole field
description: thin luminous glass HUD with cyan accents

role: Site favicon and catalog icon: keyed ship sprite composited over a cosmic disc
Audio feedback: thrust hum, capture chime, planet bounce, death boom, level-up sting
